rationale: C19 is a direct drafting antecedent: it uses nearly identical language to close the same enumerated federal offices for one half day on December 24, excuse the same categories of federal employees, and preserve the same exceptions for special public reasons and existing law. The child principally updates the year and weekday, adds a second half-day closure for December 31, and adds a compensation-and-leave provision. C10 independently shares most of this machinery but concerns a full-day closure after Christmas. C23 plausibly informs the child's treatment of the designated half-days as holidays, but is less complete as a template for the directive as a whole.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the several executive departments, independent establishments, and other governmental agencies in the metropolitan area of the District of Columbia, including the General Accounting Office, the Government Printing Office, and the Navy Yard and Naval Stations, shall be closed one-half day on Thursday, December 24, 1953
